description: A Java class implementing a Liquibase custom task that generates and assigns UUIDs to database table rows. Supports different databases (MySQL/MariaDB vs others) and handles special cases for table ID columns.

classes.name: GenerateUuid
classes.description: A class implementing custom task to generate UUIDs for database tables, with support for different DBMS and handling exceptions in ID column naming.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method that connects to the database and inserts UUIDs into specified tables, using database-specific approach for UUID generation.

methods.name: getConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Returns a success message indicating completion of UUID assignments.

methods.name: setFileOpener
methods.description: Sets the resource accessor, but implementation is empty in this class.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes internal variables based on input parameters, prepares SQL statements, and parses exception mappings.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Returns validation errors; in this case, always empty indicating no validation issues.

methods.name: setTableNames
methods.description: Receives and stores table names parameter for processing.

methods.name: setColumnName
methods.description: Receives and stores the column name parameter for UUIDs.

methods.name: setIdExceptions
methods.description: Receives and stores special ID exception mappings for certain tables.
